### Lord, I Want to be Like This Woman - Encouragement for Today - December 18, 2015
Author: Liz Curtis Higgs
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/lord-i-want-to-be-like-this-woman-encouragement-for-today-december-18-2015.html
Passage: Luke 2:37
Points:
- Anna responded to early loss and widowhood with persistent prayer and worship rather than bitterness.
- Her spiritual discipline of fasting and worship prioritized intimate fellowship with God over physical comfort.
- Decades of devotion prepared her heart to immediately recognize and approach the Christ child.
- Encountering the Savior prompted spontaneous thanksgiving rather than complaint about long years of waiting.
- Anna boldly proclaimed the Redeemer to everyone in the temple, providing a model for sharing Christ today.

### Diligence - God's Love at Work - Week of November 10
Author: God's Love at Work
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/a-womans-walk-week-of-october-24-11610242.html
Passage: Luke 2:37
Points:
- Anna channeled her life after widowhood into devoted, continuous worship in God's presence.
- Believers can cultivate similar diligence by seeking God's heart and obeying Him in everyday settings like work.
- Consistently pursuing intimacy with the Lord prepares believers to recognize His presence and voice.
- God honored Anna's faithful seeking by choosing her to proclaim the Messiah's arrival to others.
- Believers are challenged to maintain Christ as their first love throughout the entire year, not just holidays.
